description:
Deploy and manage temporary previews of pre-built static web applications and PWAs.

Use this app when a built frontend artifact is available via an HTTPS URL and needs to be published for review or testing.

It can:
- create a temporary preview from a ZIP or tar.gz artifact URL
- list existing previews
- inspect a preview
- update an existing preview while keeping its URL
- extend a preview's lifetime
- delete a preview

This service does not build source code. Build the application elsewhere first, then provide the resulting static artifact URL.
